create or replace package body billing_api as
  procedure pay(p_bill_id in number, p_amount in number) is
    v_remaining_balance NUMBER;
  begin
    insert into bill_payments (bill_id, amount) values (p_bill_id, p_amount);

    -- Calculate remaining balance after payment
    -- Assuming the bills table has a column for the original amount and a column for the current balance or amount_due.
    -- Based on the context, I assume 'amount_due' should be the column representing the total amount owed for the bill.
    -- If 'amount_due' is not the correct column name, this fix relies on it being the correct one for the total amount.
    select (b.amount_due - NVL(SUM(bp.amount), 0)) into v_remaining_balance
    from bills b
    left join bill_payments bp on b.bill_id = bp.bill_id
    where b.bill_id = p_bill_id
    group by b.amount_due;

    -- Update bill status if balance is zero or less
    if v_remaining_balance <= 0 then
      update bills
      set status = 'PAID'
      where bill_id = p_bill_id;
    end if;

  exception
    when no_data_found then
      -- Handle case where bill_id might not exist, though usually handled by caller
      null;
  end pay;
end billing_api;
/
